scope: Browser integration of the production WorkspaceMembersPanel and MemberPopover with production styles; synthetic voice participants and mocked profile API

regression.before_fix: Two focused Chromium tests failed: workspace clicks left the desktop profile open, and the close header had opacity 0 without hover.
regression.change: Register a document capture-phase pointerdown listener while the profile is mounted, ignore events inside the profile, and remove it on unmount. Make the close button always visible. Preserve the outside control's focus on desktop, and restore participant focus for Escape, the close button and modal dismissal.

checks.name: Member profile browser regressions
checks.command: cd clients/web && CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' npm run test:member-popover
cases: Dismiss from voice stage, header, sidebar and roster, including stopped event propagation
Visible close button and restored focus
Profile clicks and volume drag keep profile open and update volume
Dismiss loading and failed profile states
Mobile backdrop, Escape, button and volume controls

checks.name: Visual inspection
checks.observations: Close button visible; desktop card floats beside roster; mobile sheet keeps readable controls and backdrop. Screenshots generated in ignored .out/member-popover-browser-results; no generated images committed.

continuous_integration: tools/ci/native/web.py runs npm run test:member-popover on every web check
